term: first, simple, one, dependence and Intellect in Plotinus V.4
resolution: First as globally prior is distinguished from source-minimality in a selected relation and from temporal beginning. Simplicity of each individual is distinguished from unity of a plurality or the whole explanatory domain; the claim that a pair would not be one is not a checked derivation from individual noncomposition alone. Constitutive need is not silently CausesIn, actual world-local causation or PriorSimply. Intellect means the source’s thinking/intelligible structure, not every account of cognition; beyond ousia is not identified without a bridge with Thomistic subsistent esse or its negation. Derivation from the first may be immediate or mediated, so the scope claim does not make every derivative a direct effect.
